title: MainRewarder.stake() Return Value Not Checked
description: The deposit() function calls MainRewarder.stake() without verifying the return value. If staking fails silently, the contract accounting will assume staking occurred when it did not.
impact: If staking fails silently, TOKE rewards will not be earned while the accounting assumes staking occurred. This could result in loss of expected yield for depositors.
recommendation: Check the return value of stake() and revert if it indicates failure. Alternatively, use a require statement to ensure the staking operation succeeded.
